answer: Charge a burn-to-enter fee that anchors each identity to a destroyed payment: to join a task pool, an agent must verifiably burn a small amount of network tokens, and the fee doubles for every further identity funded from the same source. One honest agent pays a trivial cost, but to forge a reef of a thousand fake identities burns a fortune, since each copy costs twice the last and the money is gone forever, not staked and refundable. Burn receipts are public, so anyone can count how much skin each identity actually destroyed.
